attestations.attested_by: Claude Code agent (deployment-record verification, on maintainer request)
attestations.note: Verified 2026-10-13 from deployment and workflow-run records, not from a settings read: the environments API is blocked from this session (403 at the egress proxy), so the required-reviewer rule is attested by its observed effect rather than by reading Settings. All github-pages deployments from 2026-07-25 through 2026-10-13 entered state "waiting", and each of today's successful Deploy GitHub Pages runs (110-113) carries an "approved" deployment review by IRsoctierDT for github-pages; a wait timer would auto-release and produce no such review. Scope limits, all material: the environment object reports can_admins_bypass=true, so a repository admin can deploy without the gate and the control's "before any deploy" is not absolute; the approver is also the run's triggering actor, so this is operator confirmation, not second-person review; and the rule has NOT been continuously in force — 22 deployments between 2026-07-19T11:14Z and 2026-07-24T03:24Z (runs 31-53) went straight to "in_progress" with no "waiting" state and no approval record, a gap the prior 2026-07-24 attestation did not disclose. The environment's updated_at (2026-07-10) does not track protection-rule edits and must not be read as evidence of continuity.
